script.title: THE BIRTHDAY ROOM
script.scene_zh: 活動中心 · 預約生日派對房間
script.story_hook: A mom books a party room for her kid's birthday.
script.intro_zh: 一位媽媽為孩子的生日預約一間派對房。
script.welcome_en: Great to see you again, everyone! Today we're booking a birthday party room.
script.welcome_zh: 又見面了各位！今天我們要預約一間生日派對房。
script.outro: Date held, deposit paid, cake handled. Parties are sorted.
script.outro_zh: 日期留住、訂金付好、蛋糕也搞定，派對穩啦。
script.practice_intro_en: Say each line out loud with me now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在請你大聲地跟我說每一句。

script.char_b_description: a patient venue coordinator in his late twenties with curly dark hair and a trimmed mustache, wearing a teal polo with a lanyard badge, clicking a pen over a booking calendar
script.youtube_title: 【🎂預約派對房英文】「外帶食物可以，但別點蠟燭」？🎉場地規則一次聽懂，線上付訂｜🎈A2 聽力練習｜Party Room Booking
script.youtube_title_en: “Outside Food Is Fine, Just No Candles” — Booking a Birthday Party Room
script.youtube_description:
想幫孩子辦生日派對，卻怕講不清人數與規則？這段家長與場地窗口人員的對話，教你選日期、問人數上限、了解蛋糕與蠟燭規定、線上付訂留位。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Planning a kids' birthday party in English? This venue booking conversation covers it all. A mom picks a Saturday, checks the guest limit, learns the candle rule, and pays a deposit online to hold the date. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a listen-and-repeat section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎂預約派對房英文｜挑選日期・人數上限・訂金留位｜聽完就會訂場地｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
幫孩子辦生日派對，用英文訂房間該說什麼？
人數、蛋糕、訂金，規則一個都怕聽錯？

這一集帶大家走進商場裡的兒童活動中心，跟著一位媽媽從挑星期六的日期、確認人數上限，到弄懂蠟燭規定與線上付訂留位，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🗓️ 挑日期留位：例如「I'd like to book a party room.」、「June sixth or the thirteenth?」。
👥 人數與規則：例如「Our rooms hold fifteen guests」、「outside food is fine, just no candles.」。
💳 付訂與付款：例如「there's a fifty deposit」、「can I pay it online today?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下個派對，就換你自信訂房！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a calendar with a circled Saturday
script.title_quote: Outside food is fine, just no candles

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to book a party room.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈpɑrti rum/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想預約一間派對房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了！你們想約什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ideally a Saturday in early June.
dialogue.zh: 最好是六月初的某個星期六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, June sixth or the thirteenth?
dialogue.zh: 那，六月六號還是十三號？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sixth works. It's my daughter's seventh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɪks wɜrks ɪts maɪ ˈdɔtərz ˈsɛvənθ/
dialogue.zh: 六號可以，那天她滿七歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy birthday to her! How many kids?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ tə hɜr haʊ ˈmɛni kɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 祝她生日快樂！大概幾個小朋友？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fourteen kids, and two adults, I guess.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔrˈtin kɪdz ænd tu əˈdʌlts aɪ ɡɛs/
dialogue.zh: 十四個小朋友，加上兩位大人吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our rooms hold fifteen guests, so no worries.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər rumz hoʊld ˈfɪftiɛn ɡɛsts soʊ noʊ ˈwʌriz/
dialogue.zh: 我們的房間可容納十五位賓客，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh great! Can we bring our own cake?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡreɪt kæn wi brɪŋ ˈaʊər oʊn keɪk/
dialogue.zh: 喔太好了！我們可以自帶蛋糕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, outside food is fine, just no candles.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˌaʊtˈsaɪd fud ɪz faɪn dʒʌst noʊ ˈkændəlz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，外帶食物可以，但不能點蠟燭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No candles? Is that a safety thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkændəlz ɪz ðæt ə ˈseɪfti θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不能點蠟燭？這是基於安全考量嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, we light one on our cupcake stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp wi laɪt wʌn ɑn ˈaʊər ˈkʌpˌkeɪk stænd/
dialogue.zh: 對，我們會在杯子蛋糕架上點一根。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 老實說，那樣聽起來更可愛！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To hold the date, there's a fifty deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /tə hoʊld ðə deɪt ðɛrz ə ˈfɪfti dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 要留住這個日期，需付五十元訂金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, can I pay it online today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr kæn aɪ peɪ ɪt ˈɑnˌlaɪ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我今天可以線上支付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I'll email you the link now.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs aɪl ˈimeɪl ju ðə lɪŋk naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我現在就 email 連結給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. We're really excited about this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt wɪr ˈrɪəli ɪkˈsaɪtɪd əˈbaʊt ðɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So are we! It's going to be fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɑr wi ɪts ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə bi fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我們也是！一定會很好玩。
